36 |  *   { start: new Date(2014, 0, 10), end: new Date(2014, 0, 20) },

43 |   intervalLeft: Interval,

49 |   ].sort((a, b) => a - b);
50 |   const [rightStart, rightEnd] = [
51 |     +toDate(intervalRight.start),
52 |     +toDate(intervalRight.end),
53 |   ].sort((a, b) => a - b);

57 |   if (!isOverlapping) return 0;
